items.claim: Amanda Lemos has fought a higher level of competition.
Amanda Lemos hits very hard and is going to land harder than her opponent has ever been hit.
items.quote: Lamos hits hard, man. Lamos is going to hit Tina harder than she's ever been hit.

items.claim: Tinara has poor striking defense with her chin floating in the air.
items.quote: that chin is just floating out there in the air. It is a bad bad bad technique issue

items.claim: Tinara has a lot of volume and activity in her striking, but lacks substance against higher-tier competition.
items.quote: there's a lot of volume there's a lot of activity. I just I just don't think there's a whole lot of substance to it once you move up to a certain point.

items.claim: Tai Miller has a reach and height advantage and knows how to use it well.
items.quote: Ty Miller's got the reach. Seems to know how to use it.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff has poor striking defense.
items.quote: boy, his striking defense leaves a lot to be desired.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff has been hurt to the body previously.
items.quote: he's been hurt to the body before.

items.claim: Tai Miller possesses a great jab and educated hands.
items.quote: Tai's got really really educated hands. Uh he's got a great jab.
